summary: Pitney Bowes Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing Credit Agreement, extending the maturity of its revolving credit and term loan A facilities by five years and adjusting financial maintenance covenants (interest coverage, secured net leverage, total net leverage) with step-down thresholds through 2029. The facilities remain guaranteed by domestic subsidiaries and secured by substantially all assets. No M&A, activist, or other special-situations event occurred; the filing is a routine refinancing of outstanding debt without change to loan amounts. No price, premium, or advisor is noted. Watch for covenant compliance trends; no risk-arb angle.
